tickets.title: Evaluate lapse and reinstatement of Paper Otter Life policy
tickets.text: Evaluate lapse and reinstatement options for Soren Cloudpuddle's $750,000 20-year Paper Otter Life term policy after the premium draft failed when his Teacup Comet Bank checking account was replaced, prioritizing action before existing underwriting terms are lost.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term coverage and disability protection
tickets.text: Review Soren Cloudpuddle's term coverage and disability protection after Lila Cloudpuddle reduced paid work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary with mortgage, childcare, and education-funding exposure.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
